If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to counteract pessimism.  
In mid-horizon (8–15 days), if sentiment swings from positive to negative, shift forecast downward by 0.5–1.0% per sentiment reversal.  
In late-horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is positive but forecast is trending downward, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% in late horizon to align with sentiment momentum.  
If sentiment is negative but forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% in late horizon to avoid sentiment mismatch.
